_schema.description: Curated font families for izkor yahrzeit sheets. Generated by scripts/copy-fonts.mjs from the tziyun-berega font fork; every file provenance-verified (license + coverage tag). Files are full subsets (no subsetting) named <weight>-full.ttf. cantillation:false families lack Hebrew cantillation marks (U+0591-05AF) and should only be used for nikud-only rendering.
